description: For a short visit (tourism or business): what a passport needs to enter a destination — no visa, an electronic travel authorisation (ETA), an eVisa, a visa on arrival or a visa — read from the destination's own official list, with the verbatim sentence, the official URL and the date it was read. Says plainly when we have not read the destination's list, or when the list does not name the passport.

destination.description: The destination: name, ISO code or slug, e.g. "Japan", "JP"

passport.description: The passport's country: name, ISO code or slug, e.g. "India", "IN"

name: check_visa
title: Does a passport need a visa to visit a country?
